title: dev.qory.run.log
description: One chunk of the session's output. On pipes: one line or 4096 bytes, whichever comes first, cut at a byte, so a multibyte character may straddle two chunks. On a pseudo-terminal: 4096 bytes or a quiet gap of 50 ms after the runtime's last write, whichever comes first, never cut inside a multibyte character, and a line break cuts nothing. The bytes are the runtime's, uninterpreted; output.log is their concatenation in sequence order.

stream.description: terminal on a pseudo-terminal; stdout or stderr on pipes.
